name: Attack
description: Make NPC(s) attack another NPC / the player.
guided_description: Start a deadly fight. Use when someone attacks or draws steel on the NPC, an arrest is resisted with violence, a bandit or enemy meets prey, or someone with a real reason to kill is pushed past breaking point. Never for insults alone (use Brawl or words) or misheard speech.
prompt: If an NPC says something highly offensive, begin your response with '{key}:'
